days.title: Gorillaz — The Mountain Tour Atlas
days.description: Follow Gorillaz across 23 US and Canada venues, explore each concert’s setlist, and play the songs through Spotify or YouTube.

days.title: Seattle, a City of Climbs
days.description: Explore Seattle’s steep street segments in 3D, rank recorded grades, and inspect interactive terrain elevation profiles.

days.title: Election Night Atlas
days.description: Follow 2026 US House, Senate and governor races with congressional district and state polygons, candidate returns, filters and source timestamps.

days.title: Warehouse / Country
days.description: Explore Inland Empire warehouse concentrations alongside surrounding buildings, with neon clusters, footprint views, and sourced neighborhood context.

days.title: Seattle Sightlines
days.description: Trace views from the Space Needle to Seattle landmarks in 3D, test your own points, and explore how terrain and buildings shape what you can see.

days.title: Neon Japan
days.description: Travel from Sapporo to Okinawa in eight guided levels, exploring real Japanese terrain through a 16-bit sci-fi console with pixel landscapes and neon beacons.

days.title: Seven Days of Shaking
days.description: Explore a week of USGS-reported earthquakes around the Pacific and beyond, with magnitude-sized circles and clickable event details. Built in a ten-minute working window.

days.title: UTOPIA — No Fixed Destination
days.description: Explore an imagined terrain atlas through seven synchronized album excerpts, with 19 track locations and a personal choice of utopia.

days.title: Somewhere Between
days.description: Compare Seattle and the valley on two maps at the same scale, exploring population density, growth boundaries, and designated working land.

days.title: Waterfront Flight
days.description: Pilot a simulated drone above Portland’s Willamette waterfront and watch its live first-person view alongside the 3D city scene.

days.title: Puget Sound, Below the Surface
days.description: Explore four hydrophone sites around Puget Sound and hear narrated examples of orca calls, a ferry, and a harbor seal.

days.title: When Power Changed
days.description: Compare the leading electricity sources by country from 2000 to 2025 and trace the years when the lead changed.

days.title: Interactions
days.description: Show how places and systems affect one another, or invite the viewer to interact with the map.

days.title: Borgesian map
days.description: Explore the boundary between a place and its representation, inspired by the idea of a map at impossible detail.

days.title: Inside out
days.description: Reverse a familiar perspective, reveal an interior, or turn a conventional map’s logic inside out.

days.title: Collaborative map
days.description: Make a map with another person and document how the shared decisions shaped the result.

days.title: Light & dark
days.description: Use illumination, shadows, or contrasting tones to reveal a geographic story.

days.title: NULL
days.description: Interpret absence, missing values, or an intentionally open theme through a map.

days.title: Smell
days.description: Consider how scents, their sources, and the experience of smell can be represented geographically.

days.title: Hexagons
days.description: Use hexagonal shapes or grids to organize locations, compare values, or explore a spatial pattern.

days.title: OpenStreetMap
days.description: Build from OpenStreetMap data or contribute to the shared geographic record through mapping.

days.title: Projections
days.description: Explore how representing a globe on a flat surface changes shape, distance, direction, or perspective.

days.title: Taste
days.description: Explore food, drink, ingredients, or the places and experiences connected with taste.

days.title: Network
days.description: Map the connections that link places, people, routes, or other parts of a system.

days.title: Is this a map?
days.description: Test the edges of cartography with an experiment that blends geographic thinking, art, and visualization.

days.title: Water
days.description: Explore water’s places, movement, boundaries, or role in shaping the landscape.

days.title: New tool
days.description: Try an unfamiliar tool in the mapmaking process and document what the experiment teaches.

days.title: Feeling
days.description: Translate an emotion, atmosphere, or felt experience of place into a geographic expression.

days.title: Raster
days.description: Build a geographic story with pixels, imagery, or another continuous gridded surface.

days.title: Pen & paper
days.description: Make an analog map by hand, then photograph or scan the finished work for the collection.
